rename.to: Cannot find module '@angular/common/http/src/response after migrating to Angular 8

body: Try `@angular/common/http`. I'm pretty sure you have to always import from the barrels, aka `@angular/common/http` ... never from src files, as that is considered private and can change any time.

Hm, seems like it's not part of the public api https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/f8096d499324cf0961f092944bbaedd05364eea1/packages/common/http/public_api.ts, even though `HttpDownloadProgressEvent` is, but `HttpUploadProgressEvent` isn't. Maybe it was forgotten?
Yes, even if I import it from `@angular/common/http`, the compiler complains. I believe indeed this is a bug ?

This seems indeed to be an unintentional omission in 37797e2b4. `HttpUploadProgressEvent` should be added to the public API [here][1] (as @sod mentioned above) and also add the `@pablicApi` annotation [here][2] (similar to [HttpDownloadProgressEvent][3]), so that it shows up in the docs.

In any case, you should never import from `@angular/<package/entrypoint>/src/...`. Everything that should be publicly importable, should be part of the public API.

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/32886cf9ace539e14e2b387cd8afb10715c8d3de/packages/common/http/public_api.ts#L17
[2]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/32886cf9ace539e14e2b387cd8afb10715c8d3de/packages/common/http/src/response.ts#L87-L91
[3]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/32886cf9ace539e14e2b387cd8afb10715c8d3de/packages/common/http/src/response.ts#L74

Hi @gkalpak ,
Can i work on this.
